children.value: > Fact From Story: The case, filed by Arkansas-based publisher Helena World Chronicle, argues that Google “siphons off” news publishers’ content, their readers and ad revenue through anticompetitive means.
> > Fact From Story: It also specifically cites new AI technologies like Google’s Search Generative Experience (SGE) and Bard AI chatbot as worsening the problem.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Siphoning content, readers, and ad revenue is an anticompetitive practice.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Google’s Search Generative Experience (SGE) and Bard AI chatbot are Google products.
